note: Sidebar chrome (user status, icon buttons, dividers) -- renders: fixed icon buttons and status indicators; the rooms list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Sidebar top bar -- renders: fixed section title and icon buttons
Sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels like 'Channels' or 'Direct Messages'
Sidebar user profile block -- renders: current user's display name and status (self-authored)
Room header chrome -- renders: fixed action buttons (search, info, etc.); the room title is subtracted as it is a user-created name
Message box chrome -- renders: 'New message' button and 'Jump to recent' button; the message list is subtracted as it contains user-generated content
Message input area -- renders: fixed input controls, emoji picker, and formatting toolbar buttons
